While Basal Cell Carcinoma can also have a central crater, the overall morphology and surface characteristics align more closely with Keratoacanthoma.
follow_up_considerations: Obtain a biopsy to confirm the diagnosis and rule out other potential malignancies.
Monitor the lesion for any changes in size, shape, or symptoms.
Consider referral to a dermatologist for a detailed evaluation.
